LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL JULY 11, 2006
AGENDA PAGE 3
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
July 11, 2006
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on July 11, 2006, at 7:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF A CERTIFICATE OF APPRECIATION FROM GILBERT BURCIAGA TO THE CITY COUNCIL BY THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY FOR SUPPORTING THE 2006 RELAY FOR LIFE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF REGULAR MEETINGS OF JUNE 13, 2006 AND JUNE 27, 2006 AND CORRECTED MINUTES OF MAY 9, 2006
6-13-06 Minutes
6-27-06 Minutes
5-09-06 Corrected Minutes
Lujan moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of June 13, 2006 and June 27, 2006 and corrected Minutes of May 9, 2006; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
CONSENT CALENDAR ACTION TAKEN
Action Taken :
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Solis moved to approve Consent Calendar Items D-1 and D-2; seconded by Storing.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, and Perez. NOES: None.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1182 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2005-06
D-2
ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION CONFIRMING THE CONTINUED NEED TO MAKE EMERGENCY REPAIRS OF AN IMMINENT HAZARD ON THE HILLSIDE BEHIND 133 AND 139 ROUNDABOUT DRIVE AND 140 AND 148 HILLCREST DRIVE
Roundabout Report
Roundabout Resolution
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTION OF THE 9/80 WORK SCHEDULE
9/80 Work Schedule Rept
9/80 Resolution
Lujan moved to adopt a resolution approving the 9/80 work schedule as the hours of operation for City Hall and full time City employees ; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-2
BUDGET ALLOCATION FOR SOCIAL SERVICE ORGANIZATIONS
Allocation Report
Lujan moved to distribute $5,600.00 to Choices; $5,600 ot East San Gabriel Vallely Coalition for the Homeless; $6,000 to Girl Scouts-Spanish Trails Council; $4,000 to Meals on Wheels, $4,000 to SPIRITT; $4,000 to YWCA Wings; and direct Staff to come back with fund request guidelines for orgainizations ; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A "GRANDFATHER" CLAUSE TO ALLOW HOME OWNERS TO RETAIN RESIDENTIAL IMPROVEMENTS CONSTRUCTED PRIOR TO THE CITY’S INCORPORATION SUBJECT TO APPLICABLE SAFETY AND AESTHETIC REGULATIONS (Requested by Council Members Storing and Solis)
Grandfather Clause Rept
moved to ; seconded by .
The motion failed by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, and Storing. NOES: Lujan, and Perez.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF OPENING THE FLOOR TO DISCUSSION OF THE PROPOSED SEWER FEE AND RELATED IMPROVEMENTS (Requested by Council Member Storing)
Sewer Fee Discussion
Storing moved to open the floor for people to ask questions regarding the proposed sewer fee and related improvements ; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, and Perez. NOES: None.
